decision: Use direct supervisor JSONL protocol 7 with correlated replies.
reason: Artifact 20 chose this over another HTTP service; no worker framing or implicit daemon startup.

decision: Nest cwd/provider/model/thinking under public supervisor create.config; verify returned cwd and effective explicit model.
reason: Parent's real baseline disproved top-level supervisor fields. Unknown IDs can use a provider template, but catalog-only set_model can reject them and thinking can clamp to off.

decision: Read status from connection state, queue arrays, and session stats.
reason: Streaming/model/thinking, pending previews, and numeric cost have different authoritative native getters. Null context is unknown, not zero.

decision: Map Pi abort to abort_and_clear_queue; stop uses the same command with runtimeClosed false.
reason: Parent traced actual Pi Web server semantics. Prime lacks a public nonarchiving root-session runtime-close command.

decision: Acquire native connection-scoped input pause before archive preflight and kill.
reason: Pauses queued delivery, not all producers or in-flight work. Reject observed activity and expose preflightAtomic false; no local mutex or private close marker.

decision: Return interactive answer unsupported 501; label all queue text as previews and replay unsafe.
reason: Prime has no correlated ask registry; internal queue preview labels need not be replayable prompt text.

decision: Keep parent as live-verification owner and this worker as the sole code writer.
reason: No shared docs/worktree writes, real daemon/model calls, credential access, or provider switching by this worker.

decision: Keep archived cwd-matching list rows with native metadata and an explicit archived boolean.
reason: Parent traced actual Pi Web list behavior; filtering archived rows would break caller history/discovery.

decision: Use a quoted remote HOME prefix by default and quote every argument separately.
reason: Remote execution must not assume a username, interpolate caller text, restart Twingate per call, or consume stdin.

decision: Include the new installer helper in the synthetic bootstrap clone.
reason: The full check-overlay.sh run failed without scripts/install-agent-clis.sh; after copying that runtime dependency into the fixture the check passes.

decision: Admit runnable verification text only with --inference; cancel and clear inside the pause scope on ordinary failures.
reason: A connection-owned pause releases on disconnect. Default control checks admit no text; connection loss during inference-enabled checks can still make queued input runnable.

decision: Normalize spawn readback transport failures while retaining the known created session row.
reason: Once create replies, timeout/reset/EOF must not erase identity needed for reconciliation. No retry or automatic deletion is added.

decision: Expose durable sessionId as compatibility id on spawn/list/status; preserve native activeSessionId separately.
reason: Parent approved this revised identity contract. Fresh clients cannot depend on attachment-only rebind events. Validate durable identity, use current active IDs inside composite reads, and add no shim registry.

decision: Parse only a leading backend selection in agent-cli and exec the remaining argv unchanged.
reason: Prime's --socket is a backend option before the verb. Both --backend prime and --backend=prime must preserve it, stdin, and every later token.

decision: Use native prompt_and_wait for the authorized live inference completion probe.
reason: The real daemon persisted no assistant error row, so admission-plus-message polling timed out. The native completion response returns the exact provider refusal; a subprocess regression covers it.

decision: Stop model attempts on the native openai-codex credential refusal.
reason: Real Prime v0.10.1 returned No API key found for openai-codex. No login, credential import, or provider switch is authorized. All owned sessions were archived and both owned daemons were stopped.

decision: Retain durable SessionIdentity and encode queue previews and observed capability limits in typed boundary models.
reason: No shim registry or event cache. Fresh CLI connections validate durable identity; preview text is never promoted to replay-safe native objects.

decision: Add only queue-resume mapped to public resume_queue with no drain, prompt fallback, or retry.
reason: Completed control research proves same-session native object resumption. It can authorize model work, cannot recover cleared or withdrawn inputs, and can clear suspension before an empty-queue error.

decision: Preserve unsupported answers and the disclosed stop shim; add opt-in fail-closed runtime-close and replay-safe-clear requirements.
reason: Public question commands run side inference rather than consume user answers. Direct session-client tickets cannot shut down workers. Raw clear output loses images, provenance, and admission metadata. These tests do not implement missing parity.

decision: Use a complete endpoint-free model metadata whitelist with the observed explicit thinking-level map.
reason: Parent and operator research observed the exact metadata-only catalog row. Native custom model schema supports these declarations. Missing or extra fields fail; no model-name inference, auth reads, endpoint reads, custom provider keys, or substitutions.

decision: Disclose omitted tiered pricing, inputLimits, type, and unsupported compatibility flags.
reason: Prime v0.10.1 supports four flat rates, not the cache's above-272000-token tier. Catalog metadata is not authentication, entitlement, effective reasoning, or inference evidence.

decision: VerificationRuntime owns one dedicated daemon under the existing prepared root and temporarily registers only its native model file.
reason: Refuse sockets, locks, unsafe roots/settings, and existing models.json without reading it. Pin agent/session/socket/cwd. Control runs before explicit inference; complete metadata and effective thinking must match. No prepare or login in verify mode.

decision: Clean known owned sessions before socket-specific shutdown; wait for the launched process and remove only matching owned files.
reason: Do not attach to or shut down a colliding daemon. Native setters can change defaults, so restore the saved nonsecret settings only after the owned process stops. Preserve primary model/usage errors if cleanup also fails. No auth or log artifacts in git.

decision: Keep worker verification offline and label parity incomplete in every verifier report.
reason: All new launcher/model/usage tests use fake runtimes and sockets. Parent owns real non-inference checks and independent review. Authentication, inference, active-turn steering, compaction, and off-host access remain unverified by this writer.

decision: Validate complete metadata through public get_model_catalog, not get_connection_state.model.
reason: The real stable daemon returns only a selected-model summary. Parent reproduced that shape before the fix. Full native metadata now matches the sourced definition and local xhigh is retained; native set_model exposes typed model_provider_unauthenticated before runnable input.

decision: Exercise nonempty same-session queue resume only inside explicitly authorized inference verification.
reason: A red fixture showed the new verb was not covered by the post-login runner. Resume now occurs under the existing input pause, with unchanged previews checked before clear. G20 itself tested only an empty native queue and never submitted runnable text.

decision: Keep the ZF login root intact and use a new credential-free root for G20 real checks.
reason: All four new owned sessions were archived. Dedicated processes exited and sockets, locks, and temporary metadata files are gone. Artifact 20 contains exact source-backed operator and off-host commands; neither login nor the model-backed path was executed here.
